svg.title: Swartz logo
svg.desc: Black-and-white portrait logo of Aaron Swartz. Adapted from Aaron Swartz profile.jpg by Fred Benenson / www.fredbenenson.com, licensed under CC BY 2.0. The photograph was cropped, converted to black and white, and redrawn as vector shapes.
svg.metadata: Original photograph: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aaron_Swartz_profile.jpg Photographer: Fred Benenson / www.fredbenenson.com Source photograph license: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/ Changes: cropped, background removed, converted to black-and-white vector portrait.
